message.content:
This editorial illustration features a dark teal background with various text elements and two vehicles. At the top, "TEMPO" is written in large red block letters, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" and a red number "55" below it. Smaller white text includes "Operasi Militer Proyek Lumbung Pangan H.26" and "Akal-akalan Tender SKK Migas H.56". The central white headline reads "BANCAKAN GIZI NASIONAL," followed by smaller white text mentioning "Jaksa menangkap mantan Kepala Badan Gizi Nasional... H.38".

The central image shows a man in a black shirt, pink vest, and black pants, with his hands behind his back. He is mid-stride, stepping from the back of a clean white van on the left to the back of a rusty, dark green van on the right. The white van features a circular seal with a gold bird and "BADAN GIZI NASIONAL REPUBLIK INDONESIA," alongside the text "BADAN GIZI NASIONAL". The green van has a barred rear window and visible rust patches. At the bottom, a white box contains a barcode, QR code, "8-14 JUNI 2026," and "RP 60.000".
